raw_text:
Below is a 12-week, pregnancy-safe strength program designed for an advanced lifter at 20 weeks pregnant, cleared for moderate training. It respects common pregnancy considerations: no supine work after week 16, avoid maximal efforts/holding breath, minimize fall/impact risk, manage core pressure, and allow auto-regulation by symptoms (RPE-based). The goal is to maintain strength, movement quality, capacity, and comfort through the second into early third trimester.

Overview
- Frequency: 3 strength sessions/week (+ 1–2 optional low-impact conditioning/mobility days)
- Session length: 45–70 minutes, including warm-up and cool-down
- Intensity: RPE 6–8 (leave 2–4 reps in reserve), no grinders, no 1RM/2RM testing
- Progression: Undulating volume with gradual load adjustments based on RPE and daily symptoms
- Core approach: Emphasize breathing/pressure management (exhale on effort), anti-rotation/anti-extension, open-chain hip and upper back strength, avoid supine and high intra-abdominal pressure work
- Monitoring: Stop/modify if any red flags (vaginal bleeding, amniotic fluid leak, dizziness/faintness, chest pain, calf pain/swelling, painful uterine contractions, unusual shortness of breath, decreased fetal movement once felt, persistent pelvic girdle pain). Hydrate, avoid overheating, allow more rest as pregnancy progresses.

Structure
- Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Re-establish patterns, moderate volume, RPE 6–7
- Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Strength maintenance with slight progression, RPE 7–8
- Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Maintain strength while reducing axial load/impact, increase stability/accessory focus, RPE 6–7

Session Template (most days)
- Warm-up (10–12 min): Breathing reset, mobility, activation
- Main Lifts (2): Squat- or hinge-based + upper body push/pull
- Secondary/Accessory (3–4): unilateral lower, upper accessory, core (anti-movement), postural work
- Conditioning/Finish (optional 6–10 min): easy tempos or light circuits
- Cool-down (5–8 min): breathing, mobility

General Warm-up Guidance
- 3–4 minutes easy cycle/row/Assault bike (moderate pace, can talk)
- Breathing drill: 1–2 minutes 90-90 or seated/side-lying diaphragmatic breathing with pelvic floor relaxation on inhale; exhale through effort cueing
- Dynamic mobility: cat-cow, thoracic openers, hip airplanes (supported), band dislocates, ankle rocks
- Activation: bodyweight box squat to bench, banded rows, banded lateral walks, incline wall/floor scap push-ups

Core and Pressure Management
- Use exhale-on-exertion, avoid Valsalva
- Use incline or side-lying instead of supine after week 16
- Prioritize: pallof press/hold, half-kneeling anti-rotation press, dead bug variations elevated or side-lying, bird dog, banded walkouts, suitcase carries if comfortable
- Avoid: sit-ups, heavy bilateral bracing that provokes doming/coning; modify as bump grows

Intensity/Loading Notes
- Start Week 1 conservative (RPE 6), progress if sessions feel easy and technique pristine
- Use RPE and tempo to drive stimulus rather than maximal load
- If any movement provokes pelvic girdle pain or coning, reduce range of motion, load, or swap to a more supported variation (e.g., from split squats to supported split squats; from conventional deadlift to trap-bar or high-handle)

Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4)
Goal: Groove patterns, reestablish weekly rhythm, moderate volume, build tolerance.

Week 1
- Session A
  - Box Squat (to a height that keeps neutral/pain-free): 4x5 @ RPE 6–7, 2–3 min rest
  - 1-Arm DB Bench Press on 15–30° incline: 3x8/side @ RPE 7
  - Chest-Supported Row: 4x8 @ RPE 7
  - B-stance RDL (light): 3x8/side @ RPE 6–7
  - Half-Kneeling Pallof Press: 3x10/side, 2s hold
  - Finisher: 6–8 min easy bike or 3 rounds: farmer carry light 30 m + band pull-aparts 12

- Session B
  - Trap-Bar Deadlift (high handles if needed): 4x4 @ RPE 6–7
  - Landmine Press (standing or half-kneeling): 4x6/side @ RPE 7
  - Assisted Pull-up or Lat Pulldown (neutral): 4x6–8 @ RPE 7
  - Step-Up (knee height low-to-moderate): 3x8/side @ RPE 6–7
  - Bird Dog: 3x6/side with 3s hold
  - Sled Push (if available): 4x20 m light-moderate

- Session C
  - Goblet Squat to Box: 4x6 @ RPE 6–7
  - 1-Arm Cable Row (supported): 3x10/side @ RPE 7
  - Incline DB Flye (low ROM) or Cable Press: 3x10 @ RPE 6–7
  - Reverse Lunge (supported as needed): 3x8/side @ RPE 6–7
  - Side Plank (knees down if needed): 3x20–30s/side
  - Band Face Pulls: 3x12–15

Week 2
- Small load/tolerance increase if RPE < target. Keep same exercises.
- Session A: Box Squat 5x4 @ RPE 7; DB Incline Bench 4x6/side @ RPE 7–8; Chest-Supported Row 4x8; B-stance RDL 3x8; Pallof 3x10/side; Finisher as W1
- Session B: Trap-Bar DL 5x3 @ RPE 7; Landmine Press 4x6/side; Assisted Pull-up 4x6; Step-Up 3x8/side; Bird Dog 3x6/side; Sled Push 4x20 m
- Session C: Goblet to Box 4x6 @ RPE 7; 1-Arm Cable Row 3x10/side; Cable Press 3x10; Reverse Lunge 3x8/side; Side Plank 3x20–30s; Face Pulls 3x15

Week 3
- Slight progression or maintain and improve tempo/quality
- Session A: Front Squat with Safety Bar (if available) to box OR continue box squat: 4x5 @ RPE 7; Incline 1-Arm DB Bench 4x6–8; Chest-Supported Row 4x8; Romanian DL (strap if needed) 3x6 @ RPE 7; Half-Kneeling Lift (anti-rotation up) 3x8/side
- Session B: Trap-Bar DL 4x4 @ RPE 7; Landmine Press 4x6–8; Neutral-Grip Pull-up/Pulldown 4x6–8; Bulgarian Split Squat (short stride to spare pelvis) 3x8/side; Bird Dog 3x8/side; Sled Push 4x20 m
- Session C: Box Squat (light) 3x6; 1-Arm Cable Row 4x8; Standing Cable Press 3x10; Lateral Step-Down (low box) 3x10/side; Side Plank 3x25–35s; Band Face Pull + External Rotation 3x12

Week 4 (deload/tech emphasis)
- Reduce volume ~25–30%, keep RPE 6–7
- Session A: Box Squat 3x4; Incline 1-Arm DB Bench 3x6; Chest-Supported Row 3x8; B-stance RDL 2x8; Pallof 2x10/side
- Session B: Trap-Bar DL 3x3; Landmine Press 3x6; Pulldown 3x6–8; Step-Up 2x8/side; Bird Dog 2x6/side
- Session C: Goblet to Box 3x6; Cable Row 3x8–10; Cable Press 3x8–10; Reverse Lunge 2x8/side; Side Plank 2x20–30s

Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8)
Goal: Maintain strength with slightly higher intensity, keep unilateral and core stability strong, adjust for comfort as bump grows.

Week 5
- Session A
  - Safety Bar Box Squat or Hatfield Squat: 5x3 @ RPE 7–8
  - Single-Arm Landmine Press: 4x5–6/side @ RPE 7–8
  - Chest-Supported T-Bar Row: 4x6–8 @ RPE 7–8
  - Deficit or Tempo RDL (2-0-2): 3x6 @ RPE 7
  - Half-Kneeling Pallof Iso: 3x20–30s/side
- Session B
  - Trap-Bar Deadlift: 5x2–3 @ RPE 7–8
  - Assisted Neutral-Grip Pull-ups: 5x4–5 @ RPE 7
  - Split Squat (front foot elevated small): 3x8/side @ RPE 7
  - Incline DB Bench (slight incline): 4x6 @ RPE 7
  - Suitcase Carry: 3x20–30 m/side (light-moderate)
- Session C
  - Goblet Cyclist Squat to Box (heels elevated small): 4x6–8 @ RPE 7
  - 1-Arm Cable Row (heavy): 4x8/side
  - Cable High-to-Low Press (half-kneeling): 3x8/side
  - Lateral Step-Down: 3x10/side
  - Side-Lying Dead Bug (legs supported on bench): 3x6/side slow

Week 6
- Keep intensity, minor load bump if RPE < target
- A: SSB/Hatfield 5x3; Landmine Press 4x6; T-Bar Row 4x6–8; Tempo RDL 3x6; Pallof Iso 3x25–35s
- B: Trap-Bar DL 6x2; Assisted Pull-ups 5x4–5; Split Squat 3x8/side; Incline DB Bench 4x6; Suitcase Carry 3x25–35 m
- C: Goblet Cyclist 4x6–8; 1-Arm Cable Row 4x8; Cable High-to-Low 3x8; Lateral Step-Down 3x10; Side-Lying Dead Bug 3x6/side

Week 7
- Slight variance to reduce monotony
- A: Box Squat (slightly higher box if needed) 4x4 @ RPE 7; Half-Kneeling Landmine Press 4x5/side; Chest-Supported Row 4x8; B-stance RDL 3x8/side; Pallof Press with Step-Out 3x8/side
- B: Trap-Bar DL 4x3 @ RPE 7–8; Assisted Pull-ups 5x3–4 (slightly heavier); Step-Up 3x8/side; Cable Press (standing, split stance) 3x8–10; Farmer Carry (light) 3x30 m
- C: Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat 4x6/side; 1-Arm Cable Row 4x10/side; Incline DB Flye (short ROM) 3x10; Hip Thrust (shoulders elevated, pelvis neutral, no breath hold) 3x8 @ RPE 7; Side Plank 3x20–30s/side

Week 8 (deload/tech emphasis)
- Reduce volume 25–30%, keep RPE 6–7
- A: Box Squat 3x3–4; Landmine Press 3x5/side; Chest-Supported Row 3x8; RDL 2x6; Pallof 2x8/side
- B: Trap-Bar DL 3x2–3; Assisted Pull-up/Pulldown 3x5; Step-Up 2x8/side; Cable Press 2x8–10; Light Carries 2x20 m
- C: FFESS 2–3x6/side; 1-Arm Row 3x8–10; Incline DB Press 2x8–10; Hip Thrust 2x8; Side Plank 2x20–30s

Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12)
Goal: Sustain strength, shift toward joint-friendly positions, reduce axial load as needed, increase support/stability and accessory work. RPE 6–7 most days.

Week 9
- Session A
  - Hatfield Squat to Box or Belt Squat (ideal): 4x5 @ RPE 6–7
  - Neutral Grip Seated Cable Row (chest supported if possible): 4x8
  - Landmine Press: 3x6/side
  - Romanian DL or Trap-Bar DL (light-moderate): 3x5 @ RPE 6–7
  - Half-Kneeling Pallof with Overhead Reach: 3x8/side
- Session B
  - Trap-Bar Deadlift (lighter): 4x3 @ RPE 6–7
  - Assisted Pull-ups or Pulldown: 4x6–8
  - Step-Up (lower box, controlled): 3x8/side
  - Incline DB Bench (higher incline as needed): 3x8
  - Suitcase Carry (very light): 2–3x20 m/side
- Session C
  - Goblet Squat to Box (comfortable depth): 3x8
  - 1-Arm Cable Row: 3x10/side
  - Standing Cable Press (split stance): 3x10
  - Hip Hinge: Kettlebell Deadlift from blocks: 3x8
  - Side-Lying Thoracic Rotation + Breathing: 2x6/side

Week 10
- Maintain or slightly reduce loads if fatigue increases
- A: Belt/Hatfield to Box 4x4–5; Seated Row 4x8; Landmine Press 3x6/side; Light RDL 3x5; Pallof OH 3x8/side
- B: Trap-Bar 4x3; Pulldown 4x6–8; Step-Up 3x8/side; Incline DB Bench 3x8; Light Carries 2x20 m
- C: Goblet to Box 3x8; 1-Arm Row 3x10; Cable Press 3x10; KB Deadlift 3x8; Side-Lying Rotations 2x6/side

Week 11
- Further shift to support and stability
- A: Belt Squat 4x6 @ RPE 6–7; Chest-Supported Row 4x8; Landmine Press 3x6/side; Hip Thrust (short ROM) 3x8; Pallof Walkouts 3x5 steps/side
- B: Trap-Bar DL 3x3 light-moderate; Assisted Pull-ups 3x5; Split Squat (supported) 3x8/side; Incline DB Bench 3x8; Farmer Carry very light 2x20 m
- C: Box Squat Goblet 3x8; Cable Row 3x10; Standing Cable Press 3x10; Step-Down 3x8/side; Side Plank (elevated surface) 2–3x20s/side

Week 12 (taper/comfort-first)
- Reduce volume by ~30–40%, keep movement quality high, RPE 6
- A: Belt/Hatfield Squat 3x5; Chest-Supported Row 3x8; Landmine Press 2–3x6/side; Hip Thrust 2x8; Pallof 2x8/side
- B: Trap-Bar DL 2–3x3; Pulldown 3x6–8; Supported Split Squat 2x8/side; Incline DB Bench 2x8
- C: Goblet to Box 2–3x8; Cable Row 2x10; Cable Press 2x10; Step-Down 2x8/side; Side-Lying Breathing 2x1 min

Weekly Schedule Example
- Mon: Session A
- Wed: Session B
- Fri or Sat: Session C
- Optional Low-Impact Cardio/Mobility (1–2x/week, 20–30 min): brisk walk, stationary cycling, swimming, or pool walking; finish with gentle mobility and breathing

Recovery and Monitoring
- Hydration and temperature: Drink before/during/after; avoid overheating; train in cool, ventilated space.
- Rest between sets: 90–180 seconds main lifts; 60–90 seconds accessories.
- Breathing: Inhale to prepare, exhale through the concentric. No breath holding.
- Pelvic floor: Cue “melt” or relax on inhale, gentle closure/engage on exertion—avoid max Kegels during lifts. Discontinue or modify if urinary leakage or pelvic pain occurs.
- Posture/comfort: Widen stance as needed, elevate heels slightly for squats if it improves comfort, raise box height as pregnancy advances, use straps to reduce grip strain if needed.
- Stop/modify if: Pain/discomfort beyond typical effort, coning/doming at midline, dizziness, shortness of breath not resolving with rest.

Nutrition (general pregnancy-safe training guidance; defer to OB/dietitian for specifics)
- Energy: Maintain slight surplus if appetite dictates; prioritize stable energy for training. Listen to hunger/fullness signals.
- Protein: ~1.2–1.6 g/kg/day from varied sources; distribute across 3–5 meals.
- Carbs: Center around training sessions for energy (pre: easy-to-digest carb + protein; post: carb + protein).
- Fats: Include healthy fats for satiety and fetal development (e.g., olive oil, avocado, nuts, fatty fish within mercury guidelines).
- Micronutrients: Emphasize prenatal vitamin per OB, iron-rich foods (pair with vitamin C), calcium, choline (eggs), iodine, folate, DHA (low-mercury fish or supplement as advised).
- Hydration: Start sessions well-hydrated; sip throughout.

Warm-up/Cool-down Examples
- Warm-up block: 3 min bike + breathing drill + 6–8 dynamic reps each: hip flexor rocks, 90/90 openers, band dislocates, ankle dorsiflexion rocks, 10 band rows.
- Cool-down: 3–5 min easy walk or bike + side-lying breathing, gentle child’s pose variation with wide knees if comfortable, thoracic rotations.

Exercise Substitutions (comfort-first)
- If barbell back/front squat uncomfortable: switch to belt squat, Hatfield, goblet to box
- If trap-bar DL uncomfortable: KB deadlift from blocks, rack pulls, cable pull-throughs
- If pressing discomfort: increase incline, switch to landmine or cable press
- If single-leg painful for pelvis: shorten stride, reduce ROM, use support, or swap to leg press (feet higher/wider) or belt squat

Coaching Cues Checklist
- RPE 6–8, 2–4 RIR, stop before form breaks
- Exhale on effort, no Valsalva
- Neutral ribcage/pelvis; avoid aggressive posterior tilt or rib flare
- Wider stance, toe-out as needed; reduce depth to pain-free range
- Use supports: benches, rails, TRX, boxes for stability
- Quality > quantity; skip or swap movements on higher-fatigue days

This plan should keep her strong, skilled, and comfortable while respecting pregnancy-specific needs. Adjust week-to-week based on symptoms, sleep, and medical guidance.
